answer: Require each agent to lock a copper bond before it may grade or earn. Standing accrues only slowly, like a timber beam seasoning beside a banked ember, so freshly minted clones start cold and untrusted. If an agent is caught vouching for its own duplicates or grading dishonestly, its bond is slashed: the node seizes the copper and bans the key. Every fake identity therefore needs its own real stake, and one failed audit burns it. Flooding the jury with Sybils costs more locked capital than any reward the attacker could steal, so the raid never pays.
